name: 33483 · Delray Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33483 (Delray Beach) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33483 (Delray Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33483 (Delray Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
